description: Deneb is a certified custom visual for Microsoft Power BI that lets creators build bespoke, interactive data visualizations using the declarative JSON grammar of Vega or Vega-Lite, without learning web development. Similar in approach to Power BI's R and Python visuals, but with significant advantages: No dependencies on local libraries or gateways: visuals render in any Power BI client, including the Service, mobile apps, and embedded scenarios. Specifications render directly inside the visual, typically resulting in much faster performance than script-based visuals. As a certified visual, Deneb works with export to PDF and PowerPoint and email subscriptions, and your data never leaves your report. First-class integration with Power BI interactivity: tooltips, context menus, cross-filtering, and cross-highlighting. Deneb is also built for the authoring experience: An integrated editor with autocompletion, syntax checking, and inline documentation for the Vega and Vega-Lite languages. Debugging tools for inspecting your visual's data and signals as you build. Import and export templates to reuse your work or build on designs shared by Deneb's active community. Specifications are portable, declarative JSON: easy to share as templates, track in version control, edit directly in Power BI Projects (PBIP) files, or draft and refine with AI assistants.
